head: \paragraph{Single directions: the starting point we outgrew.}
out: The starting point that we outgrew is single directions; refusal can be steered with one residual direction~\cite{arditi2024refusal}, constructed as a mean difference over contrastive prompts. We keep that construction for our own directions and keep rank one itself only as an appendix baseline, because every strand below warns against stopping there.

head: \paragraph{Cones: the working object.}
out: \paragraph{Cones: the working object.} The behavior behind a single steerable direction spans cones and manifolds~\cite{wollschlager2025cones}, and orthogonality alone does not imply independence under intervention. Where refusal required a cone rather than a vector, writing gets the same upgrade: our object is a positive-part cone, $h - \alpha B\max(B^T(h-\mu),0)$, not a subspace. The clamp is the point; without it, the intervention removes whatever the projection catches, and the falsification suite shows that version fails.

head: \paragraph{Disentanglement: the scrub.}
out: \paragraph{Disentanglement: the scrub.} Neighboring mechanisms stay entangled until explicitly disentangled~\cite{siu2026repit}. Raw writing directions mix voice with instruction following, so we build a separate basis from paired counterfactuals (brevity, schema, facts, arithmetic, refusal-adjacent compliance) and subtract its span from the writing basis before anything is cut, with strength $\rho$. OLMo taught us the knob bites: the effect survived a light scrub and died under the full one. That death is reported, not hidden.

head: \paragraph{Local multi-directionality: why rank is searched, not assumed.}
out: \paragraph{Local multi-directionality: why rank is searched, not assumed.} Local directions sometimes beat any centroid~\cite{piras2026som}, and our own failed single-direction control independently reproduces the lesson: matching the cone burden with its top direction alone demanded $25\times$ strength per layer against a cap of four. So we fit cones per depth window across ranks 2--32 and let the validation split, never the screen maximum, choose. Rank is an outcome here, not a hyperparameter.

head: \paragraph{Narrative signal: why low rank at all.}
out: Narrative signal: why low rank at all. Authorship signal spreads redundantly across discourse dimensions~\cite{russell2026storyscope}. A phenomenon smeared across dimensions argues against rank one from the data side, exactly as the geometry argues from the mechanism side. Both point the same way, which is why the study starts at low rank with an appendix baseline rather than at rank one with ambitions.

head: \paragraph{Distribution tuning: the scale discipline.}
out: \paragraph{Distribution tuning: the scale discipline.} Large-scale distribution tuning sets the evaluation discipline we follow~\cite{rosmine2026deft}: fixed blind slices, bootstrap uncertainty, family-wise correction, and metrics that separate word habits (L2), outlier robustness (JSD), and embedding geometry (MMD, same embedder family). Where that work trains to match distributions, we intervene to test whether a small cut moves them. Same instruments, opposite direction of inference.

head: \paragraph{Evaluator favoritism: why taste stays secondary.}
out: \paragraph{Evaluator favoritism: why taste stays secondary}. Automated judges prefer machine-generated outputs, including their own~\citep{panickssery2024llmevaluators}, and judge models~\cite{laurito2025aibias}. Our judge prefers one model's outputs to actual human writing; therefore, reading blind preference serves as a taste stress test that can only falsify a quality claim, never establish one, a reading the data endorses: the claim died on it.
